label: Create VectorDialect foundation — backend-agnostic vector operations for SqliteVec + Turso
summary: Created libs/data/store/store-adapter/src/vector-dialect.ts with SqliteVecDialect and TursoVectorDialect implementations, serialization helpers, shared TopKQueryParams interface, and factory function. Added createTableDDL to the VectorDialect interface in types.ts.

changes.kind: Added createTableDDL(table: string, column: string, dim: number): string to VectorDialect interface (line 63)
NEW FILE — SqliteVecDialect, TursoVectorDialect, TopKQueryParams, vecToJson, vecToBlob, createVectorDialect factory

sqlite_vec_dialect.createTableDDL: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE {table} USING vec0({column} FLOAT32[{dim}])
sqlite_vec_dialect.createIndexDDL: returns '' — vec0 virtual table IS the index
sqlite_vec_dialect.topKQuery: SELECT … FROM {table} v JOIN node n … WHERE v.{col} MATCH ? AND k = ? AND __PLACEHOLDER__ ORDER BY v.distance LIMIT ?
sqlite_vec_dialect.initialize: no-op — vec0 tables managed by sqlite-vec extension

turso_vector_dialect.createTableDDL: CREATE TABLE {table} (node_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, {column} vector({dim}))
turso_vector_dialect.topKQuery: SELECT … vector_distance_{fn}(v.{col}, ?) AS distance FROM {table} v JOIN node n … WHERE __PLACEHOLDER__ ORDER BY distance LIMIT ?
turso_vector_dialect.initialize: no-op — Turso has built-in vector support

build.note: atomic-tsc committed to dist/ — vector-dialect.js, vector-dialect.d.ts, and corresponding .map files emitted

handoff_notes: Both dialects' topKQuery SQL include __PLACEHOLDER__ token — callers MUST replace it with actual WHERE conditions before execution. The TopKQueryParams.placeholder field (default '__PLACEHOLDER__') is available for custom tokens.
SqliteVecDialect's topKQuery args order: [vecJson (MATCH), k (AND k=?), k (LIMIT)]. The second and third positional args are both k.
TursoVectorDialect's topKQuery args order: [vecJson (distance function), k (LIMIT)].
vecToJson serializes via JSON.stringify(Array.from(vec)) — suitable for both sqlite-vec MATCH and Turso vector_distance_* functions.
vecToBlob serializes via Buffer.from(Float32Array.buffer) — suitable for Turso BLOB storage.
createVectorDialect factory accepts 'sqlite' | 'turso' string — no StoreAdapter instance needed.
The index.ts already exports from './vector-dialect.js' — the re-export was pre-set before this task.
No downstream consumer imports VectorDialect yet (checked vector-store, graph-store, memory-core) — safe to merge.
